courses.reasonForTaking: I’ve worked on a few web projects on my own while learning web development, so I was already interested in taking this course. I also chose Professor von Briesen’s class because I’ve known him since my first year of college at CPCC.

I’m interested in learning more about security and privacy, especially when it comes to building software. I want to better understand what information should be private or public and how to keep users and their data safe.

I wanted to learn more about software architecture, the development lifecycle, and how software is built as a team. I also heard this course offers some really interesting group projects and certificates, which made me excited to take it.

I’ve always enjoyed math. I already completed Calculus I and II even though they weren’t required for my major, and I also took Statistics I. Now I’m taking Statistics II to fulfill a general education requirement while continuing with a subject I enjoy.
